correctness.rationale: On an S5 cluster, every contingency value is constant. XOR with a cluster-constant bit preserves variation, so an outer contingency on a normal form tests only the local linear parity. Induction gives existence even for nested formulas and infinite clusters. On singletons with valuations 0 and e_i one recovers the constant and k local coefficients. On a cluster with an affine basis for the full span every nonzero parity varies, giving the sum T of all modal coefficients. For span s-perp only s among the nonzero parities is constant, so testing that hyperplane recovers T XOR b_s; testing all but one gives the omitted b_s from T. This establishes uniqueness and the fixed teaching family of size D=k+2^k using at most k+1 worlds. With at most k worlds the span is proper, so the number of varying parity indicators 2^k-2^(k-dim L) is even; the all-modal XOR vanishes. Conversely a combination vanishing on all such examples has zero constant and local parts by the singletons, and b_s=T for every s by the hyperplanes, making its relation space exactly one-dimensional. The full-span cluster violates the relation. For k=1 the hyperplane is the zero space and the omitted-test construction needs no hyperplane examples. Fewer than D labels give fewer than D linear constraints on a difference and cannot identify any target. That proves the class counts, both cutoff directions and optimality over the full stipulated fragment.
residual_risks: The pure-XOR fragment and one universal S5 cluster per evaluation are essential to the argument; it does not establish analogous counts for primitive modalities or another Boolean basis.

evidence: The earlier one-agent S5 language allows affine Booleans and primitive box and diamond. On a nonempty S5 class it expresses contingency as NOT(diamond phi XOR diamond NOT phi). Its classified signature is the marked valuation and the affine hull.

Its separation argument uses an affine form zero on one hull, nonzero at some valuation of the other, when the marked valuation is shared. Because both classes contain that marked valuation, the separating possibility has the same truth as the contingency of that form in the pair of compared models.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Thus the affine-hull model invariant transfers even to the restricted tests for model separation. However, counting semantic functions expressed by a restricted Boolean/modal basis is not counting its test inputs up to pointed-theory equivalence. Equal separating power on pairs of models need not give equal spaces of formula functions.

value.rationale: The restricted language is a natural precise affine test case for expressive power with a genuinely bundled operator. Its dimension classifies arbitrary syntax, the evaluation-rank loss identifies exactly what small-world testing misses, and one optimal nonadaptive family works for all targets. Counting the model signatures does not answer any of those evaluation-rank questions. The contribution is a structural classification and sharp boundary, not the bare numerical sequence.
residual_risks: The theorem neither decides general affine modal satisfiability nor gives formula length bounds or an extension to other agents or frame classes.
